rows.Kwic: 喚作竹篦則觸，不喚作竹篦則背。速道，速道！擬議不來，劈脊便棒。
若端的得一回汗出，便向一莖草上現出瓊樓玉殿；若未端的得一回汗出，縱有瓊樓玉殿，被一莖草葢却。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chushi Fanqi (楚石梵琦禪師語錄), in Chushi Fanqi's later raising. Chushi explicitly introduces Baiyun Shouduan's instruction with '白雲端和尚示眾云'; Baiyun Shouduan is the exact quoted speaker who says that after truly sweating once, jeweled halls appear on a single blade of grass, while otherwise a blade of grass covers even jeweled halls. Chushi's own comment begins only at '師云'.

rows.Kwic: 年年是好年，日日是好日。師云：瞎老婆吹火。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chushi Fanqi (楚石梵琦禪師語錄), Chushi Fanqi's New Year's Eve informal convocation. An unnamed monk is the exact speaker who advances 'every year is a good year; every day is a good day'; Chushi answers, 'a blind old woman blows the fire.' The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, exact-case search, and independent parallel witnesses preserve the exchange without naming this monk.

rows.Kwic: 大悲千手眼者，觀音大士應化之身也。
